Service                                              Startup   Current   Notes
The Service column names the snap and the app that runs as a daemon.
The Startup column says whether the service starts at boot, and the
Current column says whether it is running now, which is not the same
question: a service can be enabled and stopped by hand.
The Notes column lists the things snapd knows about the service, such
as user for a user session daemon and timer-activated for one a timer
starts, separated by commas.
snapd prints the four headings and then one line per service.
